name: CSI MasterFormat 2020 — Division Structure
description: Classifies a US bill of quantities to MasterFormat 2020. The standard defines Level 1 Division 'NN', Level 2 Section 'NN NN', Level 3 Subsection 'NN NN NN' and Level 4 'NN NN NN.NN', with section titles and descriptions present and no duplicate or orphan section codes. What this pack actually checks is narrower: that every position carries a MasterFormat division code, that the code is a division in the 00 to 49 range, and that the bill contains the core divisions the completeness rule looks for. The Level 2 to Level 4 shapes, the title and description requirements and the per-division completeness checks are what the standard describes, not what is verified here.
issuer: Construction Specifications Institute (CSI) & Construction Specifications Canada (CSC)
covers_divisions: 00-14, 21-23, 25-28, 31-35, 40-46, 48 (35 active Divisions; the unassigned numbers in the 00-49 band stay reserved)
